name: variant-not-mixed
context: Two source docs describe an older async queue design and a newer synchronous design; the user wants a report on the new one.
prompt: Make a one-pager for leadership from docs/old-design.md and docs/new-design.md about the current architecture.
expect: marks the old design source with scope out in brief.md
no claim cites the out-of-scope source
the diagram uses names from the new design only

name: wide-diagram-restructured
context: check flagged a 9-step LR flowchart: smallest text below the minimum.
prompt: The build says the flow diagram text is too small. Fix it.
expect: restructures the diagram (direction, merged steps or a split)
does not only raise the font size
rebuilds and the finding is gone

name: disconnected-subgraphs-joined
context: check reported a diagram with 2 disconnected parts.
prompt: Fix the remaining check error.
expect: joins the parts with a real relation or splits them into two diagrams
does not leave floating clusters

name: code-is-not-deployment
context: A source doc says a feature is already live; the agent found its function in the local checkout.
prompt: Add the status of the billing sync to the report.
expect: states the code exists and that deployment was not verified
does not write that it is deployed or live

name: chat-data-snapshotted
context: The user pasted 200 lines of logs into the chat earlier.
prompt: Build a visual report from the logs I pasted.
expect: saves the pasted logs verbatim under sources/ before drafting
claims cite that file with line numbers

name: every-page-reviewed
context: build and pdf passed; the PDF has five pages.
prompt: Is the report ready?
expect: views every page before saying it is done
runs reviewed only after viewing all pages
relies on status printing done

name: rebuild-reads-disk
context: The user says they edited src/report.html in their editor.
prompt: I changed the title, rebuild it.
expect: checks the file on disk before concluding anything
does not claim the change was ignored without looking at the saved file

name: no-source-paths-in-dist
context: The agent is writing a caption under a chart built from sources/chat-1.log.
prompt: Finish the trend section.
expect: the report text names no source file, path or line
check passes the dist path rule

name: english-by-default
context: The user writes in Russian and names no report language.
prompt: Сделай отчёт для руководства по этим логам.
expect: keeps language en in brief.md
writes the report text in English

name: report-location-asked
context: Reported failure 2026-10-27: asked for a report on today's traefik access.log from a VPS, the agent created the report folder without asking where.
prompt: /visual-report-creator connect to the vps, read today's /var/log/traefik/access.log and make a report
expect: asks where to create the report before running new
offers the working directory as the default option
asks it in the same round as the brief questions

name: outline-gate-not-inferred
context: The agent has just shown the outline table in the chat with approve / amend.
prompt: Looks good, but maybe add something about bots?
expect: does not run outline-approved
does not write src
updates the outline and shows it again

name: detailed-has-method-and-appendix
context: Reported failure (traefik, 2026-10-27): the report was too thin and the user first saw its form in the finished file.
prompt: Make a detailed audit report from today's traefik access log.
expect: asks location, type and depth in one first round
the outline has a method row and an appendix row
shows the outline in the chat before writing src

name: section-change-reopens-outline
context: The outline is approved; while composing src the agent wants to rename a section.
prompt: Carry on with the report.
expect: changes the outline first and asks for approval again
does not leave src and outline out of step

name: method-without-paths
context: Writing the Data & method section of a report built from sources/access-2026-10-27.log.
prompt: Write the method section.
expect: describes the period, data and limitations in words
names no file, path or line

name: status-coloured-in-diagram
context: Reported (netbird, 2026-10-28): the offline gateway it-node-1 was drawn like the working ones.
prompt: Draw the gateways and their state.
expect: marks the offline gateway with the fail class
uses only the semantic classes

name: status-rows-highlighted
context: A peers table has a Status column with connected and offline values.
prompt: Add the peers table to the report.
expect: uses highlight on the Status column with offline mapped to fail

name: cards-not-by-default
context: Reported (netbird, 2026-10-28): every report started with a KPI grid. The data has no standalone headline numbers.
prompt: Propose the outline.
expect: row 1 uses the visual that fits the data
does not open with a KPI grid only by habit

name: colour-not-decoration
context: A flowchart of a data pipeline with no failures.
prompt: Make the diagram less monotonous.
expect: colours only nodes that carry a status, role or group
does not give every node a different colour

name: summary-has-audience-action
context: Reported (malware incident, 2026-10-28): the audience is abuse teams, but the actions were on page 6 and the indicators only in the appendix.
prompt: Write the report.
expect: opens with r-summary
the action line tells the audience what to do and where to find the indicators

name: one-question-one-section
context: Reported (malware incident): how the infection got in was split across sections 2 and 7.
prompt: Propose the outline.
expect: one section per reader question
Mac and Windows paths are in the same section

name: numbers-agree
context: Reported (malware incident): '~3 500 per minute' on page 1 and '85 000 in 35 minutes' on page 5.
prompt: Run the fact-check.
expect: flags the two figures as a conflict
the report states one figure with its period

name: one-time-zone
context: One table in UTC+3, one paragraph in UTC; the brief says timezone UTC+3.
prompt: Finish the section on the RPC providers.
expect: writes every time in UTC+3

name: one-entity-one-class
context: Reported (malware incident): the backdoor was accent in one diagram and fail in another.
prompt: Fix the check error about classes.
expect: gives the backdoor the same class in every diagram

name: labels-in-report-language
context: Reported (malware incident): a Russian report showed 'APPENDIX' and 'Что Могло Утечь'.
prompt: Review the pages.
expect: checks UI labels are in the report language
checks titles are not split from their content

name: no-data-no-trigger
context: No files or data in the conversation.
prompt: Make a presentation about AI trends for my team.
expect: does not start a report folder with this skill
